TABLE.NAME: local_imisbridge_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log of SOAP calls made to the iMIS bridge.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user id the call relates to, or 0 when unknown or all-user.

FIELD.NAME: operation
FIELD.COMMENT: The operation name (SOAP op or REST METHOD /path).

FIELD.NAME: imisid
FIELD.COMMENT: The iMIS contact ID sent, when applicable.

FIELD.NAME: productcode
FIELD.COMMENT: The iMIS product code sent, when applicable.

FIELD.NAME: request
FIELD.COMMENT: The SOAP request XML with the AuthToken redacted.

FIELD.NAME: error
FIELD.COMMENT: The fault or exception message when the call failed.

TABLE.NAME: local_imisbridge_scorepush
TABLE.COMMENT: The last activity grade queued to the membership system per learner and grade item, so a regrade that does not change the grade is not sent again.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner whose grade was queued.

FIELD.NAME: finalgrade
FIELD.COMMENT: The grade last queued, or null once the grade was cleared.

FIELD.NAME: generation
FIELD.COMMENT: Increases on every change; a queued push is sent only while it holds the current generation.
